choices.why: No green velvet sofa is offered, so this dark charcoal three-seater is the closest. Its classic rolled arms and black turned legs echo the black mantel, and its deep tone keeps the user's dark-sofa idea.
A pair of wingback chairs with nailhead trim facing each other at the fireplace is a timeless, elegant arrangement for this period room.
This is the largest traditional medallion rug that suits the room. At 292×231 cm it anchors the whole group, and its charcoal and cream tones tie the sofa and chairs together.
This espresso X-base table is a solid dark wood piece with a classic profile, sized well between the sofa and the hearth.
At about 1 m wide, this gilded geometric-overlay mirror has the presence to sit centered on the chimney breast and brings refined warmth above the black mantel.
The turned-column base and linen drum shade suit the traditional look better than the chrome options.

answer.why: Charcoal, cream and dark wood with a touch of gold give a calm, classic palette. It works against the pale blue-green paneling and the black fireplace, with the medallion rug unifying the conversation group around the hearth.
